Application Data.NAME: Johnson & Associates Accounting Services
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Johnson & Associates Accounting Services specializes in providing tax preparation and accounting services for individual and business clients. Our operations are conducted primarily from our office located in Anytown, NY, with a focus on remote consultations to meet client needs. We ensure compliance with all relevant regulations and maintain robust cybersecurity measures to protect sensitive financial data. Our team is committed to delivering high-quality advisory services to help clients navigate their financial responsibilities effectively.
